title: DiversityCraft
body:
![DiversityCraft logo](https://www.diversitycraft.org/media/logo.png)

# 👋 Welcome fellow explorer, please, take a look here!

## 🌍 What is DiversityCraft?

**DiversityCraft is a community that was created back on the 4th of February 2014** as an unique, friendly and chill survival server, with a few close people playing on it. **Since it's beginning the server never had any type of moderation or rules to follow**, giving the players full freedom _(since Minecraft is a sandox game)_ to play on the server however they like to, without any restrictions. **The only limit is your immagination, you are completly free to do whatever you want on the server with no consequences.**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Xa66mcilOFk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## 🔒 Privacy by default!

The server, unlike all other servers in Minecraft, **does NOT log your IP address**. This is because _log-ips_ property is disabled by default in the server's configuration, ensuring privacy for the players! _(You can message the owner for proof, on Discord or on Reddit too)_

## 🎮 Big features?

The server runs of a custom software in order to **minimize the lag from the vanilla versions**, making sure the players have a good experience while playing. Players can utilize **various gestures, including sitting, crawling and much more!** Tired of your skin's look? **On here you can create and show your custom 3D skin** to the entire server, including your own custom animations (Follow the YouTube Tutorial [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oqoLHxgqkH8)). Simple Voice Chat is also supported, you can download the mod [on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)

Furthermore, the server implements a system to **anonymize player names in chat.**
![Anonymous chat system in action](https://www.diversitycraft.org/media/anonchat.jpg)
